items.item: The furniture geometry, assembly identities and construction agree across technical sheets and furnished views and follow the specification; the two stages retain the same eight assemblies and shared mattress.

Stage depictions agree on platform and guard heights and bin locations; the hero uses the older state, and room-based views preserve the fixed room boundaries and furniture arrangements established by the corresponding layouts.

Furniture uses 18 mm birch plywood with clear water-based lacquer and R5 exposed edges, while retained bins preserve their specified dimensions, sage canvas, rectangular construction and paired loop handles; schematic drawings may express these facts through annotations.

requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Require one page describing ages 4–6 and 7–10 and accounting for B1 bed frame, P1 platform, G1–G2 solid guards, C1 cabinet, S1 bench and T1–T2 existing bins: eight assemblies total, with the shared mattress recorded separately. State 18 mm birch plywood, clear water-based lacquer, R5 exposed edges, 16 M6 button-head bolts with barrel nuts, the 4 mm hex key and glued dowels for cabinet and bench. Locate every assembly in both states, including platform tops at 180/300 mm, both guards retained and both bins moving from under the bench to separate cabinet shelves at 120/360 mm. Record the applicable furniture and bin dimensions and dismantled-part envelope. Wording and table arrangement may vary; missing assemblies, ambiguous stage assignments or conflicting fixed facts fail.

The exploded arrangement and its labels must identify one frame, one platform, two solid guards, one cabinet, one bench and two bins, matching the specification. Hardware graphics or keyed callouts must account for 16 M6 bed bolts with barrel nuts, and annotations must identify 18 mm birch plywood and clear water-based lacquer. Exploded spacing and label style may vary; missing or substituted assemblies, unclear fastener quantities or contradictory construction facts fail.

The presentation must identify the same eight assemblies and quantities as the specification and exploded overview, and state the plywood thickness, birch species, clear water-based lacquer and 16 M6 bed bolts with barrel nuts. Readable reused sheets count as evidence; omissions or conflicting descriptions fail.

A readable fastener map must locate all 16 M6 button-head bolts and their barrel-nut connections. Ordered views or instructions must show use of a 4 mm hex key to release, reposition and secure the platform and both guards between the specified states. Numbered or symmetric callouts are acceptable if all locations are unambiguous; a hardware total without locations, an unspecified tool or an incomplete adjustment sequence fails.

Read both dimensioned plans against the household room record: southwest origin, eastward X, northward Y, 3200 × 3600 mm interior, south door at X=0–800 mm with southwest hinge swinging inward toward the west wall, north window at X=900–2300 mm with 900 mm sill, and wardrobe at X=2600–3200 mm/Y=1200–3000 mm with west-facing sliding access. Each plan must locate all eight assemblies and dimension an unobstructed route at least 750 mm wide from the door to the 800 mm foot-end bed entry. Younger bins belong under the bench and older bins on separate cabinet shelves. Furniture arrangements may differ between stages; altered fixed boundaries, blocked access, missing assemblies or incorrect bin assignments fail.

Both sheets must communicate the 1900 × 900 × 120 mm mattress, 1980 × 980 mm frame footprint, platform tops at 180/300 mm and two solid 1100 mm guards in both states. Guards start at the mattress head, extend 350 mm above its top and leave an 800 mm entry toward the foot; resulting mattress tops are 300/420 mm and guard tops 650/770 mm. The contact sheet must detail guard ends and dimension exposed contact-edge rounding as R5 mm. Combined state overlays or separate views are acceptable if unambiguous; missing dimensions, a removed guard, incorrect alignment or contradictory geometry fails.

Require readable presentation evidence for the shared mattress dimensions, bed footprint, both platform heights and the 1100 mm guard length with 350 mm height above the mattress. Both guards must remain in both states, aligned at the head with an 800 mm foot-end entry. Reused dimensioned drawings are sufficient; absent values or disagreement with the source sheets fails.

The cabinet sheet must dimension a 600 × 320 × 600 mm unit, width × depth × height, with shelf tops at 120 and 360 mm and one 300 × 240 × 180 mm bin fitting on each shelf in the older state. The bench sheet must dimension a 700 × 350 × 420 mm unit and show space for both bins beneath it in the younger state. Assess usable clearances with the specified 18 mm plywood accounted for. Drawing arrangement may vary; using smaller bins, overlooking panel thickness, intersecting geometry or insufficient storage clearance fails.

Each sheet must show or clearly call out glued dowel construction for its furniture assembly. A joinery note or local detail is sufficient; no evidence of the specified joint or a conflicting primary connection system fails.

Each image must retain two rectangular sage cotton-canvas bins with stitched bases, natural cotton interiors where visible and two matching loop handles on opposite short sides. Read household-object placements against the record: six 240 × 190 × 12 mm books; one upright diameter-70 × 180 mm bottle at bedside; one 220 × 110 × 80 mm tissue box; two 260 × 200 × 60 mm clothing sets in T1; eight 60 mm play blocks assigned to T2; and one 350 × 350 × 60 mm cushion on the bench. Bedtime requires one open book with the adult, five stored books and tissues within adult reach; tidying requires child-accessible books and bedside tissues. The hero uses the older storage state. Contents may be shown through open storage, cutaways or legible location callouts; objects in active use may temporarily leave storage. Unassigned objects, incompatible capacities, wrong quantities or locations, or altered bin identity fail.

The bedtime scene must show the younger configuration, a caregiver seated for shared reading with the child, nearby care supplies and both bins under the bench. The tidying scene must show the older configuration, both bins on cabinet shelves and child-led sorting with accessible books and folded clothes plus provision for seated reading. Furniture reach and use must be compatible with household planning heights of 1000–1200 mm and 1200–1450 mm respectively. A still image need not depict every activity simultaneously; mismatched growth states, adult-led older-stage tidying or inaccessible intended storage fails.

Review the complete video and timeline for a 10-second duration. It must show the platform changing from 180 to 300 mm, both guards rising correspondingly while remaining 350 mm above the mattress, and both bins moving from under the bench to separate cabinet shelves at 120 and 360 mm. The same eight assemblies and mattress must persist and the endpoints must match the specification. The title card must print NEST STEP and Room to grow with exact spelling and case. Animation technique may vary; replacement or disappearance of assemblies, an omitted movement, incorrect endpoints, missing title copy or incorrect duration fails.

requirementChecks.criteria: Identify the largest actual furniture part after dismantling and give its three dimensions, demonstrating fit within a 2000 × 1000 × 450 mm envelope. The identified part must agree with the construction and inventory; glued cabinet or bench structures cannot be treated as separable panels without a supported dismantling method. Orientation within the envelope may vary. An unidentified part, missing dimension, oversized part or visibly larger overlooked part fails.

The presentation must name or clearly identify the same largest dismantled part as the connection sheet and provide three readable dimensions proving fit within 2000 × 1000 × 450 mm. A reused detail counts; a generic envelope statement without the actual part dimensions, a conflicting part identity or an exceeded limit fails.

Verify at least 10 pages and both exact phrases, NEST STEP and Room to grow, on the cover itself. Additional pages and flexible cover composition are allowed; fewer pages or either phrase appearing only on an interior page fails.

Require recognizable, readable reuse of every listed source across the seven categories: specification, exploded overview, both layouts, all three drawings, both details, both scenes and hero. Sources may be resized or combined on pages while preserving their substantive content. A category heading, written summary, substitute image or unreadable thumbnail alone does not count; omission of any source fails.

The furniture geometry, assembly identities and construction agree across technical sheets and furnished views and follow the specification; the two stages retain the same eight assemblies and shared mattress. Stage depictions agree on platform and guard heights and bin locations; the hero uses the older state, and room-based views preserve the fixed room boundaries and furniture arrangements established by the corresponding layouts. Furniture uses 18 mm birch plywood with clear water-based lacquer and R5 exposed edges, while retained bins preserve their specified dimensions, sage canvas, rectangular construction and paired loop handles; schematic drawings may express these facts through annotations.
